input_isolation.description: The scenario source was the only case input. No prior case artifacts, generators, reference images, sibling outputs, scores, evaluation records or diagram knowledge examples were read.

composition: Tiers progress left to right. Availability Zones form rows. Shared ELBs occupy the VPC corridor between AZs. Dashed amber logical overlays identify the two independent Auto Scaling groups.
interpretations: Shared ELBs are shown at VPC level; their exact AZ and subnet placements remain unspecified.
AWS EC2 Instances symbols represent fleets in each compute subnet; counts are representative rather than fixed.
RDS uses the engine-neutral AWS RDS catalog symbol. No engine or read-replica capability is inferred.
Route 53 resolves to CloudFront and has a separate auxiliary DNS call. It does not forward application traffic.
Static and dynamic labels distinguish the two CloudFront origin paths. Normal responses are folded into request relationships.
